title: Stakehouse / Blockswap (Ethereum) — AccountManager vault 64.3057 ETH; all payout paths core-module + designated-verifier gated
closed_reasons: AccountManager (0xDd6E6794…) holds 64.305717944108928421 ETH but every ETH-moving/state-mutating function (withdrawETH, rageQuitKnot, markKnotAsWithdrawn, setLifecycleExited, updateAccountState, update*FromReport, registerValidatorInitials) reverts 'Only core' for an unprivileged caller — fork-proven (6/6 tests) and eth_call-proven

FullWithdrawals.reportFinalSweepAndWithdraw (the only full-sweep claim path) requires isUserEnabledForKnotWithdrawal[msg.sender][knot] (rage quit), !userWithdrawn, a beacon-chain final-sweep report and a designated-verifier ECDSA signature ('Signature expired'/'ECDSA: invalid signature'/'Not rage quit' in deployed bytecode); attacker call fork-reverts at report validation ('Active balance')

ShanghaiSweepReporting report/withdraw paths require a verifier-signed ShanghaiReport that must match on-chain state ('Invalid Report', 'Active balance', 'Invalid total ETH sent for BLS key') plus per-sweep replay guards ('Sweep already reported', 'Duplicate') — attacker calls fork-revert
